artifacts.summary: Nine-phase leaf-first plan renaming FrameClass.Discrete/.Dedekind to .ZTime/.RTime with an isolated atomic-batch constructor pass and per-phase KEEP-list guards.
Scoped inventory for the rename: naming scheme, tiered in-scope list, explicit KEEP list, coupled script/typst artifacts, leaf-first order, verification gates.

memory_candidates.content: Large Lean identifier renames must be planned leaf-first (derived statements -> validity predicates -> frame predicates -> the inductive constructors last), because renaming a constructor first breaks every dependent file at once and leaves no green intermediate state. Equally important: enumerate the coupled NON-Lean artifacts that hardcode fully-qualified declaration names before planning phases, and pin each one to the phase that breaks it. In this repo those are check-module-invariants.sh's C14 axiom baselines AND its matched #print axioms probe block (both must move together), typst-status-counts.sh's greps into a def body (which silently return 0 after a rename), the byte-for-byte-compared typst/generated/ artifacts, round-trip string parser/emitter pairs in Automation/, and scripts/nolints.json docBlame grandfather entries (hand-edit, never regenerate). A rename that only builds green has not been verified.
